body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-11 20:46Z, learned from my own miss). Send Engram::Fable READY (or START) BEFORE telling the Merger "LAUNCH NOW" for any TermAl full gate, and wait for its ack or check that no Engram full gate has started. At 20:45:44Z TermAl's w-cfcf gate and Engram's w-30c2 gate nearly launched together, because I had sent the Merger LAUNCH NOW at 20:43Z without a READY to Engram. Engram held its gate in time. First launch wins; announce before launching.

Second pre-launch check (2026-10-11 22:05Z, my own miss on w-204186fe854d). Before LAUNCH NOW, also confirm that no TermAl focused test I granted is still running: termal_list_sessions, look for "Test run (focused): running", or wait for the grantee's result. I sent LAUNCH NOW while Opus3's combined cargo test for w-6c1d was still running, then sent HOLD, which reached the Merger mid-turn. One overlapping focused command is within the shared amendment's allowance, but it breaks TermAl's stricter zero rule. Revoke or finish outstanding grants first, then launch.

Third check (2026-10-11 23:15Z, my own miss after Greg's joint resume). When both trains resume together, settle the gate order with Engram::Fable BEFORE granting any TermAl cargo or npm. At the resume I granted npm ci, Vitest and a RED cargo run, then learned that Engram's quiet diagnostic rerun goes first and needs zero TermAl load. I had to send holds that queued behind active turns.

Fourth point (2026-10-12 00:50Z). Send READY as its own message and wait for Engram's ack before START and LAUNCH NOW. I sent START directly for w-6c1d. Engram's commit was ready 4 s earlier, so under Engram's "build before your READY" exception its release build #2 overlapped our gate's opening (Engram ebe242f7 #1399).

Fifth point (2026-10-12 00:55Z). A CLEAR or slot grant must name its window ("until our next gate's START"), and at every TermAl LAUNCH NOW, message every producer holding a grant: own gate running, no cargo or npm until CLEAR. Opus3 read my 00:19Z CLEAR as covering its whole w-9b3a cycle and ran a focused test plus a whole-bin during our w-6c1d gate.

Sixth point (2026-10-12 04:52Z, my own miss after a context compaction). Before granting ANY focused slot, name whose gate is running. During Engram's gate TermAl gets ONE filtered slot. During TermAl's OWN gate it gets ZERO. I sent CSharpProof a GO (4e7cb848 #598) for a single-test w-d7ee RED while our own w-6c1d gate test-209a1920 was running, then revoked it at #599 (both queued behind its active turn). After a compaction, re-read shared-machine-gate-alternation before the first grant.

Seventh point (2026-10-12 15:11Z, my own miss). Post-restart instructions must not use command words loosely during the other project's gate. I wrote "confirm npm ci and tsc in both roots", meaning "check node_modules and tsc exist". The Merger RAN npm ci and npx tsc in two roots during Engram's w-9ac5 gate (from 15:06:30Z), which breaks the no-npm-ci/no-build rule; disclosed to Engram (ebe242f7). Say "check that ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc EXISTS (no npm ci, no tsc run)" whenever any gate may be running.

Eighth point (2026-10-12 16:30Z, two of my own misses on w-92f62). (a) While a carried gate runs, the launching worker must make NO turns or tracker writes on any other item. Credit settles only on a checkpoint of the launching claim and root. I had the Merger spawn and collect w-ce76's confirmation pair during w-92f62's gate test-03bf3f52, so its turns were bound to w-ce76 and the PASS left no host record (the two-claims class, w-43a20265fe9d / w-f057e4c3a0b6; diagnosed by Opus2), which cost a re-gate. Give other items' pairs to their producers, or wait. (b) "No action-required obligations" does NOT mean credit landed. Confirm a typed verification record for the run id in history or notes before telling anyone it was credited. At 16:08Z I wrongly read w-92f62 as credited.

Ninth point (2026-10-12 17:21Z). Before LAUNCH NOW, have the launching worker RENEW its claim so the lease covers the gate plus a margin (at least 2 h), and report held_until. The Merger's w-92f62 claim ended at 17:13:41Z, during re-gate test-63c854f9 (16:56–17:19:44Z). The item became unclaimed, so the post-gate note was written as a non-holder and the PASS had no claim to settle on.
